sentences.en: I sprayed insecticide on the outside of the mosquito net.
sentences.zh: 我在蚊帐外面喷了驱虫剂。

sentences.en: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
sentences.zh: 猎人们用结实的网捕捉到了那只野兽。

sentences.en: Gross National Product is not the same as Net National Product.
sentences.zh: 国民生产总值并不等同于净国民生产总值。
